stackVelocity.description: Pixels the moving box travels per frame (30 fps). 5 is the game's default, about 4 s for a box to cross the tower; 20 crosses it in about 1 s. Applies to the box in play and every later box, and is kept when a new game starts.

perfectRange.description: How far off, in pixels, a drop can land and still count as perfect: the box snaps into place instead of having its overhang cut off, so the tower keeps its width. 1 is the game's default (nearly exact); 0 cuts any misalignment; 15 forgives small misses.
